rules.name: Resilience of the Duellist
rules.lore: The Primal Duellist and his sons are known for their unshakable resolve, maintaining the strictest of discipline in battle even while enduring the harshest of conditions and the unrelenting assaults of the enemy. Indeed, enemy attacks seem only to strengthen them.
rules.text: While a +Shattered Legions+ unit in your army is battleshocked, its Objective Control is 1, instead of 0.

strategems.name: Returning Fury
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, weapons equipped by the target unit have +[Lethal Hits]+. Additionally, until the end of the Battle Round, while any other +Shattered Legions+ units in your army are Battle-Shocked, unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ made by the target unit score a Critical Hit.

strategems.name: Inhuman Rage
strategems.effect: Until the end of the Battle Round, ranged weapons equipped by models in the unit have +[Assault]+, +[Heavy]+, and +[Ignores Cover]+.

strategems.name: Silent Retribution
strategems.when: After an Activated enemy unit has completed its Shoot attacks.
strategems.target: A +Shattered Legions+ unit that just had one or more of its models destroyed as a result of that attacks
strategems.effect: The selected unit can shoot as if it was Activated, but it must target the enemy unit that is currently Activated, and it may only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target.

spells.name: Mind Worm
spells.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18". It suffers 1 Mortal Damage and must take a Battle-Shock test.

spells.name: Righteous Motivation
spells.effect: Select one friendly +Legion of the Duellist+ unit within 12". Until the end of the Battle-Round, the selected unit can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound Roll for its melee attacks.

spells.name: Deepening Fear
spells.effect:
Select one enemy unit within 24". Until the end of the Battle Round, the selected unit:

* Has its =flag= Leadership worsened by 1
* Has an =arrows-to-circle= Objective Control trait of 0
* Cannot use +Secure Objectives+,

upgrades.name: Scion of the Duellist
upgrades.text: At the start of the battle, gain 1 CP.

upgrades.name: Silent Command
upgrades.text: Your +Warlord+ has !Feel No Pain 5+! while it is Battle-Shocked.

upgrades.name: Grim Execution
upgrades.text: Your +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ units have +1" to their =person-running= Movement traits while they are Battle-Shocked.
